About Pedro Duarte

A short professional biography.

Pedro is a designer and developer focused on accessible design systems and thoughtful product interfaces.

He works across interaction design, component architecture, and documentation to make complex systems easier to use.

His projects explore how strong defaults and composable APIs can support teams without limiting their visual language.

Outside product work, he studies typography, browser behavior, and the details that make keyboard workflows feel dependable.

He has collaborated with distributed teams building tools for creators, engineers, and operations specialists.

Release notes

Review the changes included in this release.

Focus is now contained inside modal dialogs while they are open.

Background content becomes inert and document scrolling is restored when the dialog closes.

Internal triggers receive generated relationships to their directly owned dialog content.

Nested overlays no longer acquire controls belonging to a child overlay root.

Scrollable bodies retain the header and footer in stable positions throughout keyboard and pointer interaction.

Logical positioning keeps the corner close control aligned in both left-to-right and right-to-left layouts.
